definition: to move forward in big leaps
description: On tall orange sand dunes under a clear blue sky, a young woman in a white crop top, a flowing rust-coloured skirt and a mustard scarf leaps barefoot down the steep slope in one huge stride, arms flung up and laughing, with sand spraying from her foot. She lands and keeps bounding down towards the camera in big strides, sand flying, and runs past. Lower down two people with backpacks walk across the slope, and a line of camels rests at the foot of the dune.
